text: The official Frontiers article reports one qualitative study of patients with obstructive sleep apnea and their co-residents. In this study's KJ-method workflow, significant statements were coded with brief phrases or sentences; the original descriptions were retained in parentheses for context reference, and each coded item was recorded individually on a 3 cm by 4 cm card. This is the procedure reported for this one study, not a universal KJ-method requirement. (Publisher article, section 2.4, Data analysis.)
